name: Pip runs
brief: Pip, an orange mouse with big pink ears in a round glass space helmet, a white spacesuit with grey boots and gloves, a red-and-silver air tank on his back, a long red scarf flying behind him and a thin orange tail; running to the right, full body
note: Pip's run, drawn from the walk's rig (rigFrom): a forward lean; per half cycle contact (the front boot lands), down (that leg bends under the body), push (it pushes off behind while the other knee drives forward) and flight (both boots off the floor); the arms swing against the legs with bent elbows. The feet are placed with reach (exact spots on the floor), the arms by their direction on screen. The second half is mirrored. Redone after the owner: "it does not fully loop. And looks weird" (the first rig floated the front boot at contact and kept both hands in front).

keys.label: contact_a
keys.action: run contact: leaning forward, the near (front) boot lands on the floor ahead, the far leg trails behind with its boot up, the far arm swings forward and the near arm back, elbows bent

keys.label: down_a
keys.action: run down: the near leg bends under the body taking the weight, the body at its lowest, the far leg swings forward

keys.label: push_a
keys.action: run push: the near leg pushes off behind from its toe, the far knee drives forward and up

keys.label: flight_a
keys.action: run flight: both boots off the floor, the near leg stretched behind, the far leg reaching forward for the next step
